# Haasya Shah — Portfolio

> AI/ML developer, game developer, and creative technologist.
> Personal portfolio at https://haasyashah.dev

## About

Haasya Shah is a developer with a focus on AI/ML systems, game development, and creative
technology. Based between Canada and Kenya, currently studying at the University of Alberta.

## Sections

- **Hero** — Introduction and quick links
- **About** — Background, education, and interests
- **Projects** — Shipped games and technical projects (itch.io + GitHub)
- **Skills** — Languages, tools, and technologies
- **Contact** — Email and social links

## Projects

Haasya's projects span game development and AI/ML work. Games are published on itch.io at
https://haasyashah.itch.io/ and source code is on GitHub at https://github.com/azya404.
